title.headline: Arsenal – The Roman Legion v Chelsea – The Ottoman Janissaries

beats.headline: The drums sound
beats.line: Arsenal's Roman Legion meet Chelsea's Ottoman Janissaries.

beats.headline: The post says no
beats.line: Cole Palmer strikes the woodwork for Chelsea's Janissaries.

beats.headline: First blood
beats.line: Bukayo Saka strikes for Arsenal's Roman Legion.

beats.headline: Arsenal lead at the break
beats.line: The Roman Legion hold the field: Arsenal 1–0 Chelsea.

beats.headline: Chelsea answer
beats.line: Cole Palmer levels it for the Ottoman Janissaries. All square.

beats.headline: A warrior falls
beats.line: Moisés Caicedo is sent off. Chelsea's Janissaries fight on with ten.

beats.headline: So close
beats.line: Kai Havertz, six yards out, and the keeper saves. Arsenal's Legion groan.

beats.headline: VAR takes it away
beats.line: Nicolas Jackson's goal is ruled out. Chelsea's Janissaries are denied.

beats.headline: A late blow
beats.line: Gabriel Martinelli at 88′. Arsenal's Roman Legion strike late.
